checks.question:
Adapt the supplied three-piece programming clip for a narrower bridge opening and a revised pair of captive-nut fasteners. Work from input/initial.blend; input/source.scad is the original parametric design for reference. The long jaw, short jaw and small bridge are arranged separately for printing. Keep that arrangement and keep each piece independently editable.

Only modify the following features, with all dimensions in millimetres. On the short jaw, identify the rear pair of vertical fastening holes and their hexagonal nut pockets, at the opposite end from the small probe-board holes. Keep their distance along the jaw unchanged. Place each rear hole centre 3.0 from its nearest long side edge of the 16-wide jaw, giving 10.0 centre-to-centre spacing across the jaw. Increase both through-holes to diameter 2.7. Make both hexagonal nut pockets 5.0 across flats and 2.1 deep, opening from the same face as before.

Update the matching hole pair in the bridge to the same 3.0 edge offsets and 10.0 centre spacing. Make the through-holes diameter 2.7 and the circular screw-head recesses diameter 4.6 and depth 2.1, opening from their original face. Narrow the bridge's central rectangular opening from 7.0 to 4.0, keep it centred across the bridge, and retain its 5.0 depth and its open ends. Preserve the bridge's outside dimensions and rounded outline. The hole pattern must still correspond to the short jaw when the mating faces are brought together.

Leave the entire long jaw unchanged. On the short jaw preserve the two front probe-board holes, the pivot ears and their holes, the spring seat, the outside contour and thickness, and all geometry outside the rear fastener adaptation. Retain the original materials, orientations, positions and number of pieces. Do not globally scale or stretch the model. Each piece must remain a closed, connected solid with real through-holes and recesses, without loose filler objects or duplicate surfaces. Modified feature dimensions must be within 0.1 mm of the requirements; unaffected surfaces must stay within 0.05 mm of the initial geometry. Keep metres and Z up in the Blender and GLB deliverables. The initial CAD source is optional implementation context; your reproducible submission entry point must run through Blender as specified below and must not depend on a private authoring installation.；按本题允许修改范围检查形态或照明变化，N中已计的尺寸/数量不在此重复计分。
